title: Verification record for a focused run whose first stage crashed is rejected as "unclassified_stages: no recognized check" instead of recorded as a failed check
outcome: Verification record for a focused run whose first stage crashed is rejected as "unclassified_stages: no recognized check" instead of recorded as a failed check
acceptance: The cause is identified from source: why a completed focused launcher run whose first test stage exited abnormally (for example 0xc0000374) produces a verification record rejected as `unclassified_stages: completed run has no recognized check for focused` rather than a recognized check with a failed result.

A focused run whose recognized test stage exits abnormally is recorded as a recognized check with a failed (or crashed) result, so it is visible as a failure for credit and evaluation purposes; a run with genuinely no recognized test stage keeps a refusal that names that cause.
Behavioural tests cover a crashed first stage, a normal failure and a pass for a focused run; no text-pinning test.
